message:
The other day, we dug out our old board games while organizing our emergency supplies, and it brought back such warm memories! We realized how much fun we had just sitting around the table, laughing and strategizing over a game of Monopoly. 💡 It got us thinking—while it’s important to be prepared, we shouldn’t forget to enjoy the simple pleasures in life. Having a family game night is a great way to bond, plus it’s an excellent opportunity to talk about our emergency plans in a relaxed setting. 

What’s your favorite way to mix fun with preparedness?
